title: 第018章 清音渡疫清溪瘴，仙音济世活黎民
content_zh:
“呼——”

    半个时辰后，蔡文姬缓缓睁开双眼，吐出一口浊气。

    她的脸色终于恢复了一丝血色，只是眼底还带着淡淡的疲惫。

    “调息好了，我们继续赶路吧。”

    蔡文姬站起身，看向远方。

    前方不远处，清溪村的轮廓已然清晰可见。

    村落上空萦绕着淡淡的病气与愁苦之气。

    那病气深处，同样夹杂着一丝若有若无的魔渊浊气。

    想来村里受邪祟侵扰的百姓，还在苦苦煎熬。

    王磊快步跟上，握紧了手中的佩剑。

    “前面就是清溪村了，听说村里大半人都染了怪病，郎中束手无策。”

    “有你在，他们肯定有救了。”

    蔡文姬脚步加快，眼底满是坚定。

    不管是明面上的恶徒，还是暗处的阴毒诡计。

    不管是山野邪修，还是潜藏的魔渊势力。

    她都一一接下，一一化解。

    青螺山周边的阴霾，今日，便彻底清扫干净！

    穿过层层林木，清溪村的轮廓彻底铺展在眼前。

    相较于先前满目狼藉的落云村，这座村落房舍尚且完好。

    可整座村子笼罩在一片灰蒙蒙的病气之中。

    空气里飘着浓郁的药草苦味与萎靡气息，压抑之感有过之而无不及。

    村口的老树下，几个面黄肌瘦的村民有气无力地坐着。

    个个精神萎靡，面色泛着不正常的青灰，连抬手劳作的力气都没有。

    街巷里行人寥寥。

    偶尔传出几声断断续续的咳嗽。

    孩童的啼哭孱弱无力，听着便让人心头揪紧！

    王磊眉头紧锁，快步上前扶住一个险些摔倒的中年汉子。

    “老乡别怕，我们是清风宗的弟子。专程来肃清邪祟、诊治病患的。”

    他常年在外历练，最懂百姓对修士的敬畏与期盼。

    语气放得极其温和。

    同时悄悄催动一丝灵力，帮对方顺了顺堵在胸口的浊气。

    那名中年汉子先是一怔，随即长长吐出一口黑气，满脸诧异。

    “好舒服……身上沉重的感觉轻了大半！”

    周围几名村民也陆续回过神，眼中的戒备渐渐化作希冀。

    这段日子，他们被怪病折磨得生不如死。

    早已盼着能有高人前来相救。
content_en:
"Huh——"

    Half an hour later, Cai Wenji slowly opened her eyes and exhaled a breath of foul air.

    A trace of color finally returned to her face, but there was still a hint of exhaustion in her eyes.

    "Now that you've adjusted your breath, let's continue on our way."

    Cai Wenji stood up and looked into the distance.

    Not far ahead, the outline of Qingxi Village is clearly visible.

    There is a faint air of sickness and sadness lingering over the village.

    In the depths of the sick energy, there is also a faint trace of the turbid aura of the demonic abyss.

    I think the people in the village who have been invaded by evil spirits are still suffering.

    Wang Lei followed quickly and tightened his grip on the sword in his hand.

    "Qingxi Village is ahead. I heard that most of the people in the village have contracted strange diseases, and the doctor is helpless."

    "With you here, they will definitely be saved."

    Cai Wenji's steps quickened, her eyes full of determination.

    Whether it's a villain on the surface or a sinister plot in the dark.

    Whether it is the evil cultivators in the mountains or the hidden forces of the Demonic Abyss.

    She took them all one by one and resolved them one by one.

    The haze around Qingluo Mountain will be completely cleared today!

    Passing through layers of trees, the outline of Qingxi Village is completely spread out in front of you.

    Compared with the previous Luoyun Village, which was in a mess, the houses in this village are still intact.

    But the whole village was shrouded in a gray and diseased atmosphere.

    The air was filled with the strong bitter taste of herbs and the smell of malaise, which made the feeling of depression even worse.

    Under the old trees at the entrance of the village, several villagers with sallow faces and skinny muscles sat feebly.

    All of them were listless, their faces glowed with an abnormal grayish color, and they didn't even have the strength to raise their hands to work.

    There are very few people walking in the streets.

    Occasionally there were a few intermittent coughs.

    A child's cry is feeble and feeble, and it makes people's hearts tighten when they hear it!

    Wang Lei frowned and quickly stepped forward to help a middle-aged man who almost fell.

    "Don't be afraid, fellow villagers, we are disciples of the Qingfeng Sect. We are here specifically to eliminate evil spirits and diagnose and treat patients."

    He has been practicing abroad for many years, and he understands best the people's awe and expectations for monks.

    The tone was extremely gentle.

    At the same time, he quietly activated a trace of spiritual power to help the other party smooth out the turbid air blocked in his chest.

    The middle-aged man was startled for a moment, then let out a long breath of black air, his face full of surprise.

    "It's so comfortable...the heavy feeling on my body has been reduced by half!"

    Several surrounding villagers also came to their senses one after another, and the wariness in their eyes gradually turned into hope.

    During this period, they were tortured by strange diseases to the point of death.

    I have long been looking forward to someone coming to rescue me.
title_en: Chapter 018 The voiceless voice overcomes the epidemic and the clear stream miasma, and the fairy voice helps the world and revitalizes the people.
